description: This file is a shell script defining a series of test cases for verifying GPG signature verification during git pull operations. It sets up repositories, executes git commands with various signature verification options, and checks for expected outputs or errors.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that should succeed, running the given commands and checking for expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test completes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if a pattern exists in a file or command output.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets configuration options for the test environment.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets global configuration options for the test environment.
